> **Semanas 12-13 del programa:** Clasificación y discriminación — enfoque clásico
> (LDA, QDA), métodos de AA/ML (SVM, Random Forest), métricas de desempeño,
> validación y comparación.

---

# 1. Datos y variable objetivo

Se clasifica cada lote en tres niveles de calidad según su puntaje total
(suma de los 10 atributos sensoriales):

- **Alta:** percentil > 75 del puntaje total
- **Media:** percentil 25–75
- **Baja:** percentil < 25

```{r datos}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(MASS)         # lda(), qda()
library(e1071)        # svm()
library(randomForest) # randomForest()
library(caret)        # confusionMatrix(), train()
library(car)

data_raw <- read.csv("../data/arabica_data_cleaned.csv")

vars_originales <- c("Aroma","Flavor","Aftertaste","Acidity","Body","Balance",
                     "Uniformity","Clean.Cup","Sweetness","Cupper.Points",
                     "Moisture","Category.One.Defects","Category.Two.Defects",
                     "altitude_mean_meters")

datos <- data_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(altitude_mean_meters),
         altitude_mean_meters > 0, altitude_mean_meters <= 3000) %>%
  select(all_of(vars_originales)) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(.)) %>%
  rename(Sabor=Flavor, Retrogusto=Aftertaste, Acidez=Acidity, Cuerpo=Body,
         Uniformidad=Uniformity, Taza.Limpia=Clean.Cup, Dulzura=Sweetness,
         Puntaje.Catador=Cupper.Points, Humedad=Moisture,
         Defectos.Cat1=Category.One.Defects, Defectos.Cat2=Category.Two.Defects,
         Altitud=altitude_mean_meters)

vars_sens <- c("Aroma","Sabor","Retrogusto","Acidez","Cuerpo","Balance",
               "Uniformidad","Taza.Limpia","Dulzura","Puntaje.Catador")
vars_11   <- c(vars_sens, "Altitud")

# Transformación YJ
datos_t <- datos[, vars_11]
pt_11   <- powerTransform(datos_t, family="yjPower")
lambdas <- pmax(pmin(coef(pt_11, round=FALSE), 3), -3)
for (v in names(datos_t)) datos_t[[v]] <- yjPower(datos_t[[v]], lambdas[v])

# Variable objetivo: nivel de calidad
puntaje_total <- rowSums(datos[, vars_sens])
q25 <- quantile(puntaje_total, 0.25)
q75 <- quantile(puntaje_total, 0.75)

datos_t$Calidad <- factor(
  case_when(puntaje_total > q75 ~ "Alta",
            puntaje_total < q25 ~ "Baja",
            TRUE                ~ "Media"),
  levels = c("Alta", "Media", "Baja")
)

cat("Distribución de clases:\n")
print(table(datos_t$Calidad))
```

---

# 2. Partición train / test

```{r split}
set.seed(42)
idx_train <- createDataPartition(datos_t$Calidad, p=0.75, list=FALSE)
train     <- datos_t[ idx_train, ]
test      <- datos_t[-idx_train, ]

cat("Train:", nrow(train), "lotes  |  Test:", nrow(test), "lotes\n")
```

---

# 3. LDA — Análisis Discriminante Lineal (clásico)

```{r lda}
modelo_lda <- lda(Calidad ~ ., data=train)
pred_lda   <- predict(modelo_lda, test)

cm_lda <- confusionMatrix(pred_lda$class, test$Calidad)
cat("Exactitud LDA:", round(cm_lda$overall["Accuracy"]*100, 1), "%\n")
print(cm_lda$table)
```

```{r lda-viz, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
scores_lda <- as.data.frame(predict(modelo_lda, datos_t)$x)
scores_lda$Calidad <- datos_t$Calidad

ggplot(scores_lda, aes(LD1, LD2, color=Calidad)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.35, size=1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("Alta"="#27ae60","Media"="#f39c12","Baja"="#e74c3c")) +
  labs(title="LDA — Mapa discriminante (LD1 vs LD2)",
       x="Discriminante 1", y="Discriminante 2") +
  theme_minimal() + theme(panel.grid.minor=element_blank())
```

---

# 4. QDA — Análisis Discriminante Cuadrático

```{r qda}
modelo_qda <- qda(Calidad ~ ., data=train)
pred_qda   <- predict(modelo_qda, test)

cm_qda <- confusionMatrix(pred_qda$class, test$Calidad)
cat("Exactitud QDA:", round(cm_qda$overall["Accuracy"]*100, 1), "%\n")
print(cm_qda$table)
```

---

# 5. SVM — Máquinas de Soporte Vectorial (AA/ML)

```{r svm}
modelo_svm <- svm(Calidad ~ ., data=train, kernel="radial",
                  cost=1, gamma=0.1, probability=TRUE)
pred_svm   <- predict(modelo_svm, test)

cm_svm <- confusionMatrix(pred_svm, test$Calidad)
cat("Exactitud SVM:", round(cm_svm$overall["Accuracy"]*100, 1), "%\n")
print(cm_svm$table)
```

---

# 6. Random Forest (AA/ML)

```{r rf}
set.seed(42)
modelo_rf <- randomForest(Calidad ~ ., data=train, ntree=300, importance=TRUE)
pred_rf   <- predict(modelo_rf, test)

cm_rf <- confusionMatrix(pred_rf, test$Calidad)
cat("Exactitud Random Forest:", round(cm_rf$overall["Accuracy"]*100, 1), "%\n")
print(cm_rf$table)
```

```{r rf-importancia, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
imp <- as.data.frame(importance(modelo_rf))
imp$Variable <- rownames(imp)
imp %>%
  arrange(desc(MeanDecreaseAccuracy)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=reorder(Variable, MeanDecreaseAccuracy), y=MeanDecreaseAccuracy)) +
  geom_col(fill="#2563a8", alpha=0.8) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title="Random Forest — Importancia de variables",
       x="", y="Disminución media de exactitud") +
  theme_minimal()
```

---

# 7. Comparación de clasificadores

```{r comparacion}
resultados <- data.frame(
  Modelo    = c("LDA (clásico)", "QDA (clásico)", "SVM (AA/ML)", "Random Forest (AA/ML)"),
  Exactitud = c(cm_lda$overall["Accuracy"], cm_qda$overall["Accuracy"],
                cm_svm$overall["Accuracy"], cm_rf$overall["Accuracy"]),
  Kappa     = c(cm_lda$overall["Kappa"], cm_qda$overall["Kappa"],
                cm_svm$overall["Kappa"], cm_rf$overall["Kappa"])
) %>% mutate(across(c(Exactitud, Kappa), ~ round(.*100, 1)))

resultados %>% arrange(desc(Exactitud))
```

```{r comparacion-viz, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
ggplot(resultados, aes(x=reorder(Modelo, Exactitud), y=Exactitud, fill=Modelo)) +
  geom_col(alpha=0.85, width=0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label=paste0(Exactitud, "%")), hjust=-0.1, size=4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#1a4a7a","#2563a8","#27ae60","#6c8ebf")) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title="Comparación de exactitud — clásico vs AA/ML",
       x="", y="Exactitud en test (%)") +
  ylim(0, 105) +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position="none",
                           panel.grid.minor=element_blank())
```
